card: Clears Taproot signatures and MuSig2 nonces/signatures when joining PSBTs via PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput. Previously, joinpsbts stripped legacy signatures but retained stale Taproot signatures, causing SignTaproot to skip signing and leaving joined P2TR transactions impossible to complete or finalize without manual intervention. The PR adds the missing clearing calls for v0 PSBTs alongside an RPC functional test.
changed_since_previous: None; previous description was generated without a recorded diff.
evidence: PR description demonstrates that a signed P2TR PSBT after joinpsbts causes walletprocesspsbt and finalizepsbt to return complete: false, whereas P2WPKH inputs re-sign and complete properly.

Author adds a test in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py verifying that joined Taproot PSBTs strip key path signatures and can be successfully completed, confirming it fails on master and passes with the patch.
problem: When combining PSBTs via joinpsbts, previous signatures become invalid for the new transaction. While legacy and SegWit v0 signatures were already cleared, Taproot and MuSig2 signature and nonce fields were never added to AddInput. Because SignTaproot skips signing if a key-path signature is already present, joined PSBTs containing signed Taproot inputs cannot be signed or finalized via walletprocesspsbt or finalizepsbt without manually editing the PSBT.

risk.why: Incorrectly modifying PSBT input-clearing logic could drop valid signature data prematurely or corrupt multi-party PSBT workflows.

scope_notes: Small 4-line fix to src/psbt.cpp with an accompanying functional test.
summary: Clears Taproot and MuSig2 signature and nonce fields when adding inputs during PSBT joining in PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput. This ensures that combining PSBTs strips invalidated Taproot key-path and script-path signatures as well as MuSig2 partial signatures and public nonces.
